capabilities: edit vault notes directly from a chat side panel
run two dozen vault tools such as read, search, write, edit, move, trash, and rewrite frontmatter
hand off self-contained tasks to parallel subagents
connect remote MCP servers and reuse skills from the vault or ~/.pi folders
stage tap-to-run suggestions for missing frontmatter and broken links while writing
extras: Installation is via BRAT or manual release files; it writes and deletes without confirmation dialogs, error reporting is on by default, API keys are stored in plaintext on mobile, and streaming is off by default because of requestUrl limits. Donations (coffee) are solicited; MIT licensed. Detailed docs live on separate pages for tools, extending, settings, and security.
problem: AI assistants for Obsidian typically hand back text the user must copy and paste into notes; this plugin instead performs the file operations itself.

relations.evidence: Piem runs on @earendil-works/pi-agent-core, the pi agent runtime
It grew from lhr0909/pi-obsidian. Thank you for that starting point.
the skills you already wrote for pi work here unchanged

requires.name: Any OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-messages provider endpoint and API key

summary: Agentic AI side panel that reads, writes, and edits vault notes directly from chat, using vault tools, subagents, skills, and MCP servers.
